{{Top}}
A '''ray shield generator''' was used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] generator was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] as [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] air locks.

A ray shield also shielded the thermal exhaust port on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
